The naval figure who appears in every December entry in Samuel Pepys’s diary—except the December 1668 entries—is **Sir Edward Montagu (later the 1st Earl of Sandwich)**.  

*Pepys’s own records and later commentaries note that Montagu is named in the December sections of the diary from 1660 through 1667 and again in the April‑to‑10 December 1668 period, but his name is omitted in the full December 1668 entries.*
